title: GTA 6 Xbox build leak: was Rockstar hacked? Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Rockstar Games, Take-Two, Microsoft, Discord, any news outlet, court, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: No count of affected people applies. Large rests on potential reach, not a measured impact: the best-selling game launch is the subject, the files are widely shared, and fake copies may carry malware. Revisit if Rockstar or Take-Two confirms what was taken.
who_is_affected: Rockstar Games and Take-Two, whose build is said to be leaked. People who download fake copies could be hit by malware, per the outlets' warnings.

known.text: A court ordered subpoenas issued to Microsoft and Discord in August at Take-Two's request, over earlier leaks.

not_known.text: Whether Rockstar or Take-Two says the files are real or that it was breached.
Whether the files, including the executable the leaker says it posted on Nov 23, are genuine.
How the leaker got the build, and who is behind it. The root cause is not published.
